not-found.title: This page doesn't exist
not-found.description: Nothing in Solyx lives at this address.

review.title: Trade review
review.description: Closed positions, from the first buy to the sale that left none, grouped by the stance of the report in force at the first buy. Before fees and tax.
review.empty: No position has been closed yet.

watchlist.title: Watchlist
watchlist.empty: Search a symbol, then add it from above its chart.

heat-map.title: Today's moves
heat-map.description: Holdings are sized by market value and watched listings share their part equally. The deeper the colour, the bigger the move; it is full at ±5%.
heat-map.empty: Add listings to your watchlist or hold some, and their moves today show here.

sectors.title: Listed sectors
sectors.description: Each tile is a TWSE sector index, sized by the value traded today. The colour is how far the index moved; it is full at ±3%. Press a group or a tile to zoom into that group.
sectors.unavailable: Set up a market data source in Settings to see the sectors.

movers.title: Sector movers
movers.description: The companies that moved a sector's market value most in the exchange's last session: each one's shares times its change. Listed companies only, as the sector indices are.
movers.summary: Session of {{date}}: worth {{value}} {{currency}} at the close before, moved {{change}} ({{percent}})
movers.none: No session the exchange has published lists this sector's companies.

chart.setup-required: Set up {{source}} in Settings to load this chart.

news.title: News and posts

gauge.hint: News and posts from the last {{days}} days, scored by the decisions model; 50 is neutral. Newer stories weigh more, and a score resting on too little recent news shows —. Press is what companies, outlets and regulators publish, crowd what investors post. A story told many times counts once.
gauge.unscored: Set up a decisions model to score sentiment

coverage.missing: What it would have found since may be missing. Automatic collection retries a source that keeps failing every few hours; asking the agent tries it right away.

news.empty: Nothing collected in the last 7 days. News is collected at the interval set in Settings, or when you ask the agent.

headlines.title: Headlines
headlines.description: The stories that weigh most about what you hold and watch over the last {{days}} days, by source, relevance, reach and recency.
headlines.unfollowed: Hold or watch listings, and the stories that weigh most about them show here.
headlines.empty: Nothing collected about what you hold and watch in the last {{days}} days. News is collected at the interval set in Settings, or when you ask the agent.

calendar.title: Coming up
calendar.description: Dates over the next {{days}} days for what you hold and watch: dividends, shareholders' meetings, filing deadlines, trading restrictions, dates the agent's reports hold, economic releases and market holidays. Filings, releases and holidays are Taiwan's only for now.
calendar.unfollowed: Hold or watch listings to see their dividends, filings and report dates here, with their markets' economic releases.
calendar.empty: Nothing on the calendar in the next {{days}} days.
calendar.unread: Couldn't read the fundamentals of {{symbols}}, so their dates may be missing.
calendar.deadline-hint: The latest day the rules allow; the company may well report earlier.

report-hints.set: The day its source says is set.
report-hints.deadline: The latest day its source gives; it may well come earlier.
report-hints.expected: A day its source only expects; nobody has set it.

kinds.ex-rights: Goes ex-rights, {{amount}} in stock a share
kinds.dividend-payment: Pays its dividend, {{amount}} cash a share
kinds.altered-trading: Altered trading, paid in full in advance

calendar.figures-unread: Couldn't read the economic figures of {{markets}}, so their releases show without any.
calendar.release-page: Open the agency's page for this release
calendar.release-deadline-hint: The latest day the agency set; the figures may well come out earlier.
calendar.schedule-unread: Couldn't read every market date of {{markets}}, so economic releases or closures may be missing.
calendar.empty-day: Nothing on the calendar that day.
calendar.empty-span: Nothing on the calendar in these days.

themes.title: Themes
themes.description: Events in the world that could reach what you hold over time. Each is searched once a day and stays quiet until news matches one of its signposts.
themes.empty: No themes yet. Ask the agent to follow a topic, or write one in Settings.
themes.no-web-search: Themes are not searched until a web search vendor's key is saved.
themes.no-decisions: What their searches find is not read against their signposts until a decisions model is set up.
themes.unread_one: {{count, number}} item found is not read against every signpost yet.
themes.unread_other: {{count, number}} items found are not read against every signpost yet.

agent.title: Agent
agent.delete-description: Its messages are erased from this computer and can't be restored. Proposals it made stay in the queue.
agent.empty-title: Ask about a listing or your account
agent.empty-description: The agent reads charts, indicators and your paper account. It can suggest an order, and each one waits for you to confirm it.

store-failed.title: Solyx can't reach your conversations
store-failed.description: Reading or saving them failed, so the agent has stopped. Restart Solyx to carry on: what was saved is kept, and a run that was cut off continues.

agent.model-unavailable: {{model}} can't run: {{provider}} needs a key or sign-in, or is switched off. Pick another model, or set it up.
agent.setup-description: Pick a provider and save its API key, or sign in to its subscription, to start.

context-meter.label: Context used
context-meter.title: Context window
context-meter.summarized: Older messages are summarized as it fills.
context-meter.hint: Typing /compact does the same, followed by what the summary should keep.

compaction.nothing-old: Nothing to summarize yet: the latest messages are always kept as they are.

commands.compact: Summarize earlier messages to free up context

notices.error: The agent stopped with an error
notices.interrupted: Solyx closed before the agent finished.
notices.store-failed: Solyx could not save this conversation, so the agent stopped here. It carries on once Solyx restarts.

link.title: Open this link?
link.description: It opens in your browser. The agent wrote it, so check the address first.

approval-mode.label: How should the agent's actions be allowed?

descriptions.ask: Tool calls and shell commands wait for you to allow them
descriptions.auto: Shell commands judged harmless run on their own, pages this conversation found are read, and the agent saves what it learns about you to memory; everything else still asks
descriptions.bypass: Tool calls and shell commands run without waiting for you

approval-mode.auto-unjudged: Pages this conversation found are read, and the agent saves what it learns about you to memory; everything else still asks, shell commands too until you set up a decisions model
approval-mode.failed: Couldn't change how tools are allowed

approval.title: Allow this call?
approval.description: {{tool}} comes from an MCP server outside Solyx. Check what it's about to send.
approval.shell-description: This command runs on your computer with your access to its files and the network. Check it before you allow it.
approval.read-page-description: Your web search vendor will fetch this address. One you didn't expect could be a page the agent read trying to send your data out, so check it before you allow it.
approval.remember-description: The agent wants to keep this for later conversations, and reads it in every one. Check it says what you mean.
approval.forget-description: The agent wants to forget this memory, so later conversations won't know it.
approval.save-theme-description: The agent wants the app to watch this theme. Once you allow it, the app searches it once a day on your web search key and reads what it finds against its signposts.
approval.change-setting-description: The agent wants to change this setting. It applies at once, as if you changed it in Settings.
approval.save-task-description: The agent wants to keep this scheduled task. Once you allow it, Solyx sends this message on its own while it's open, each run in a conversation of its own that spends your model's tokens. You can change or remove it in Settings.
approval.run-task-description: The agent wants to run this scheduled task now, in a conversation of its own that spends your model's tokens. A repeating task counts its next run from this one.
approval.change-watchlist-description: The agent wants to change your watchlist. The app collects news for every listing you watch, and tasks that wait on a change run for them.
approval.auto-allowed-found: allowed: an address this conversation found
approval.auto-allowed-memory: saved without asking, as this conversation allows

welcome.title: Welcome to Solyx
welcome.description: An agent analyzes the market and proposes trades, and every order waits for you to confirm it. Market data, models and web search use your own keys, and data comes straight from each provider to this computer.

done.title: You're set
done.description: You can change any of this in Settings.
done.paper-note: Orders go to a paper account, so no real money moves.

restart.label: Setup guide
restart.description: Walk through Solyx's first-run setup again.

inbox.title: To handle
inbox.description: Proposals to confirm, calls to allow, and research the news or the calendar has overtaken. Each leaves once it's handled.
inbox.approval: A call waits for you to allow it

proposals.form-description: Proposals pass the risk checks here and again when you confirm them.

basis.report: Made under report revision {{revision, number}} ({{stance}}, revised {{date}})
basis.none: Made with no report on this listing

proposals.reconcile: Look it up at the broker

failure.unknown: Submission failed; check your broker before placing it again
failure.refused: The broker refused it; nothing was placed
failure.interrupted: Submission failed; check your broker before placing it again
failure.interrupted-detail: Solyx closed before the broker replied, so the order may have reached it.
failure.absent-detail: Its session is over and the broker lists no order from it.

lock.label: Lock orders
lock.on: Every order is refused until you unlock.
lock.off: Proposals can be confirmed and sent.

premise.impact-most: At most {{amount}} {{currency}} at the limit-up {{price}} (before fees and tax)

flows.title: Flows
flows.hedging-note: Dealers' hedging follows the warrants they issued rather than a view.
flows.futures: TAIEX futures, net open interest in contracts
flows.listing-empty: No flows reported for this listing.
flows.market-description: What foreign investors, investment trusts and dealers bought and sold across Taiwan's market, its margin and their TAIEX futures positions. The exchanges publish a session's figures between 15:00 and 21:00 Taipei.

trends.title: Filed figures
trends.monthly: Monthly revenue on the year, unaudited

research.title: Research
research.empty: No research yet. Ask the agent for a deep analysis to get a report and a forecast.

report.falsifier-stated: News may say this happened, read as stated at {{share}}:
report.price-within: Last {{price}} on {{date}}, inside it: {{low}} from its low and {{high}} from its high
report.price-below: Last {{price}} on {{date}}, under it: {{low}} from its low
report.price-above: Last {{price}} on {{date}}, over it: {{high}} from its high
report.event-passed: Passed. The agent says what came of it when it next revises the report.
report.stale: A newer quarter, ending {{date}}, came out after this report was revised. The agent revises it before its next forecast.
report.quote-read: Quote read as stating it: {{share}} likely ({{model}})

watch.off: News is not read against these, so no signal here says nothing of the news.

gaps.no-local-embedder: It takes grouping news by meaning, with vectors from Ollama.
gaps.unmeasured: The Ollama model has no floor measured for it; {{models}} has one.

watch.pending: Not read against the news yet; the listing's next news collection reads them.
watch.failed: Reading them against the news failed {{time}}: {{failure}}. The next collection tries again.
watch.read_one: Last read {{time}}, against {{count, number}} news item of the week before.
watch.read_other: Last read {{time}}, against {{count, number}} news items of the week before.
watch.quiet: None has read as stating one.
watch.unread_one: {{count, number}} item near one could not be read; the next collection reads it again.
watch.unread_other: {{count, number}} items near one could not be read; the next collection reads them again.

forecasts.title: Forecasts
forecasts.record: {{settled, number}} of {{count, number}} settled · mean Brier {{brier}}
forecasts.motions: MAGI: {{held, number}} of the {{calls, number}} scenarios it carried held, {{expected}} expected of history
forecasts.evidence: decisions model: the close landed on the side it read the facts towards {{held, number}} of {{calls, number}} times, {{expected}} expected of history
forecasts.strip: What each forecast gave the band that held, oldest first; the line is history's share. {{led, number}} of the {{settled, number}} settled gave it the most.
forecasts.mark-history: {{date}}: gave the band that held {{given}}, history {{history}}

forecast.distributed: judged with {{cash}} gone ex added back
forecast.evidence: Its {{count, number}} facts as a decisions model read them: good news {{good}} · mixed {{mixed}} · bad news {{bad}}

magi.title: MAGI
magi.question: Is each scenario more likely than its history says?

order-form.rationale-placeholder: Kept with the proposal for later review

risk.premise-stale: Proposed for the {{date}} session, which has passed; propose it again
risk.premise-unknown: The market as it was proposed wasn't kept; propose it again
risk.price-moved: The price has moved from {{proposedAt, number}} to {{price, number}} since it was proposed, more than {{max, number}}%; propose it again
risk.orders-locked: Orders are locked; unlock them to trade
risk.daily-loss-reached: Today's sales lost {{loss, number}} {{currency}}, reaching your {{max, number}} {{currency}} limit; only sales can go
risk.invalid-quantity-tw: Taiwan orders must be 1–999 odd-lot shares or a multiple of 1,000
risk.invalid-quantity-us: US orders must be a positive whole number of shares
risk.invalid-price: Price {{price, number(maximumFractionDigits: 4)}} is not a multiple of the {{tick, number(maximumFractionDigits: 4)}} tick size
risk.odd-lot-market-order: Odd-lot orders must be limit orders
risk.outside-price-band: Price is outside the daily limit band {{low, number}}–{{high, number}}
risk.missing-reference-price: Market orders are sized at the session's limit-up price, which is not known for this listing
risk.order-too-large: Order value {{notional, number}} {{currency}} exceeds the {{max, number}} limit
risk.session-not-allowed: Orders are not allowed in the {{session}} session
risk.unsupported-market: The account does not trade {{market}} listings
risk.insufficient-cash: Order value {{notional, number}} {{currency}} exceeds the {{cash, number}} {{currency}} in the account
risk.cash-unknown: The broker can't tell how much {{currency}} the account can spend, so buys are refused
risk.insufficient-shares: Selling {{quantity, number}} shares, but the account can sell only {{held, number}}

settings.title: Settings
settings.language-description: System follows your computer's language, or English when there's no translation for it.
settings.time-zone-description: For the app's own times, such as messages and memories. Charts and market hours keep each exchange's.
settings.theme-description: System follows your computer's light or dark appearance.
settings.palette-description: Pick one for light and one for dark; the theme decides which one shows.

palette-editor.title: Edit {{name}}
palette-editor.name: Name
palette-editor.based-on: Starts from {{name}}; colors you haven't changed follow it.
palette-editor.preview-body: Muted text, such as hints and labels, reads like this.
palette-editor.delete-body: A light or dark appearance that uses it goes back to {{base}}.

settings.price-colors-description: By market follows each market's own convention: red for a rise in Taiwan, green in the US.

market-data.title: Market data
market-data.description: Keys and sign-ins are encrypted by your operating system and never shown again.
market-data.source-description: Where charts and live bars for Taiwan listings come from.

source-hints.fugle: With your own Fugle API key.

market-data.limits: {{symbols, number}} live symbols; {{intraday, number}} intraday and {{historical, number}} history requests a minute

fundamentals.title: Fundamentals
fundamentals.description: Statements, monthly revenue and dividends of Taiwan listings come from FinMind, which works without a token. Trading restrictions come from the exchanges' open data.

finmind.limit: Up to {{requests, number}} requests an hour with the token.

secrets.unavailable: This computer has no secure storage, so keys and sign-in details can't be saved. On Linux, install and unlock GNOME Keyring or KWallet, then restart Solyx.
secrets.unreadable: The saved value can't be decrypted on this computer anymore, for example after moving to another computer or user account. Enter it again.
secrets.replace-placeholder: Enter a new value to replace the saved one

fugle-api-key.label: API key
fugle-api-key.hint: The API key from your Fugle account.

fubon-personal-id.label: ID number
fubon-personal-id.hint: The ID number your account is under, e.g. A123456789.

fubon-api-key.label: API key
fubon-api-key.hint: A key from Fubon's API key page.

fubon-cert-password.label: Certificate password
fubon-cert-password.hint: Leave it unset if it's your ID number.

decisions-api-key.label: API key
decisions-api-key.hint: A key from the TypeSafe console.

cloudflare-api-key.label: API token
cloudflare-api-key.hint: A Cloudflare API token with the Workers AI permission on the account below.

openai-decisions-api-key.label: API key
openai-decisions-api-key.hint: An API key from the OpenAI platform; signing in with ChatGPT doesn't cover the Decisions API.

embeddings-api-key.label: API key
embeddings-api-key.hint: An API key from the OpenAI platform; signing in with ChatGPT doesn't cover embeddings.

ollama-embeddings-api-key.label: API key
ollama-embeddings-api-key.hint: Only if your Ollama sits behind a proxy that checks a bearer token.

finmind-token.label: FinMind token
finmind-token.hint: FinMind answers without one, up to 300 requests an hour; a free account's token raises that to 600.

otlp-headers.label: OTLP headers
otlp-headers.hint: In the format of OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS, such as the authorization Grafana Cloud shows. Leave it empty if your collector needs none.

backup-access-key-id.label: Access key ID
backup-access-key-id.hint: The ID of an access key that may read and write the bucket, such as an R2 API token's.

backup-secret-access-key.label: Secret access key
backup-secret-access-key.hint: The secret that goes with the access key ID.

backup-passphrase.label: Passphrase
backup-passphrase.hint: Encrypts each backup, which opens only with the passphrase it was made with. Solyx can't recover it, so keep a copy elsewhere.

sign-in.continue-in-browser: Finish signing in in your browser; this page updates once it returns.
sign-in.enter-code: Enter this code on the page your browser opened:
sign-in.code-page: If no page opened, go to {{url}}

fugle.description: Market data on your own Fugle API key. Pick the plan the key belongs to, and Solyx paces its requests to it.

fubon.description: Market data through your Fubon Securities account, signed in with an API key and the certificate exported from Fubon's website. A key limited to market data can't place orders.

sdk.label: SDK folder
sdk.hint: The folder extracted from the Node.js SDK (fubon-neo-<version>.tgz) downloaded from Fubon.

certificate.label: Certificate
certificate.hint: The .pfx file exported from Fubon's website.

fubon.signed-out-hint: Solyx signs in when a Taiwan chart first needs data.

agent.title: AI agent
agent.description: Switch on the providers you want, each on your own API key or subscription. Every conversation can pick its own model.
agent.default-description: Default model: what a conversation runs on until you pick another
agent.provider-is-default: The default model's provider, so it stays on
agent.auth-description: A subscription runs the agent on your plan's allowance instead of billing each request.
agent.endpoint-description: Change it only for a gateway that speaks this provider's own API. Your key is sent there too.
agent.server-endpoint-description: Where {{provider}} listens. On another machine, your conversations are sent there.
agent.server-key-hint: Only if a proxy in front of {{provider}} checks a bearer token.
agent.server-models-description: Ones that call tools and hold 48K tokens or more. Pull one with ollama pull.
agent.endpoint-invalid: Enter an http or https URL

subscription.label: {{provider}} account
subscription.hint: Signs in through your browser, on {{provider}}'s own page; this row updates once it is done.

key-sign-in.label: {{provider}} account
key-sign-in.hint: Signs in through your browser, where {{provider}} creates a key for Solyx in your account, and saves it here.

agent.model-description: Larger models reason better and cost more per message.
agent.thinking-description: How long the model thinks before it answers. Models that don't reason ignore it.
agent.decision-mode-description: Who judges the agent's forecasts and order proposals. The MAGI are three units that vote, and two votes carry: an order they reject isn't proposed, and a forecast keeps their votes. Each vote costs three more requests, and you still confirm every order.

personas.melchior: The scientist: what the data and the evidence show.
personas.balthasar: The mother: what could be lost, and whether standing aside is what the evidence called for.
personas.casper: The woman: what the crowd wants now, and what standing aside gives up.

web-search.title: Web search
web-search.description: Finds news and posts for the news sources, and lets the agent search the web and read pages, on your own key.
web-search.in-use-description: In use: the vendor news and the agent search through

key-hints.firecrawl: A key from your Firecrawl dashboard. Firecrawl searches Google.
key-hints.exa: A key from your Exa dashboard. Exa searches its own index.
key-hints.tavily: A key from your Tavily dashboard. Tavily's news searches can't favor a market's country.

news.title: News
news.description: The agent reads Taiwan companies' material announcements and PTT's Stock board. With web search set up, it also searches news and posts on Threads in Taiwan and X in the US, using the vendor's credits.

decisions.title: Decisions model
decisions.description: Answers typed questions with probabilities, on your own key: it scores news and posts, checks the quotes in the agent's research, and judges shell commands in conversations set to Allow for me. These stay off until it is set up.
decisions.in-use-description: In use: the provider whose model scores news, checks quotes and judges commands
decisions.account-id-description: The Cloudflare account that runs Workers AI, shown on its overview page.

model-descriptions.typesafe: The model's id. The questions were evaluated on the default, so another version may judge differently.
model-descriptions.cloudflare: The model's id: clef, or the faster clef-flash. The questions were evaluated on the default.
model-descriptions.openai: The model's id; gpt-6-luna is the only decisions model OpenAI offers so far.

decisions.base-url-description: Where requests go. Change it only for a proxy or a compatible service.
decisions.base-url-invalid: Enter an http or https URL

embeddings.title: Group news by meaning (experimental)
embeddings.description: Groups stories from different outlets about one event, even when their titles are worded differently.
embeddings.enabled-description: Off, stories are told apart by their titles alone.

provider-descriptions.local: A model Ollama runs on this computer; nothing leaves it.
provider-descriptions.local-host: Ollama on {{host}}. News, your reports, memories and searches are sent there.
provider-descriptions.openai: OpenAI's model, on the key below. Titles and the start of snippets are sent to OpenAI.

embeddings.measured: Measured: Solyx knows how alike this model reads one story.
embeddings.unmeasured: Not measured: vectors are kept but don't group stories until a threshold is measured for this model.
embeddings.base-url-description: Where Ollama listens. Change it to use Ollama on another machine.
embeddings.base-url-invalid: Enter an http or https URL

local-model.title: Model in Ollama
local-model.unreachable: Nothing answers at {{host}}. Open Ollama, or install it first; Solyx finds it on its own.
local-model.missing: Download {{model}} into Ollama, or run {{command}} in a terminal.
local-model.pulling: Keeps going if you leave this page.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Playbooks the agent reads when a task calls for one. Your own go in {{skills}} and come ahead of the built-ins; those in {{shared}} are offered once you switch them on.
skills.instructions-description: Rules the agent keeps in every conversation, such as your risk budget, written in {{path}}. The whole file is sent with every message.
skills.warnings-title: Some skill files don't follow the Agent Skills format
skills.shell-description: Lets the agent run commands on this computer, which skills need for their scripts. Each one waits for you unless a conversation is set not to ask. Commands aren't sandboxed, so one you allow can read and change your files and reach the network. Paper accounts only.
skills.shell-label: Let the agent use the shell

memory.title: Memory
memory.description-text: What the agent remembers about you and how you trade, read in every conversation. Deleting a conversation keeps what it saved.
memory.enabled-description: Off, memories stay saved but go unused.
memory.empty: No memories yet. The agent saves one as it learns about you.
memory.secret: A memory can't hold a key, token, password or ID number

collections.title: What the app collects
collections.description: Work the app does on its own while it's open, without a model. The overview shows what it collects, and the agent's tasks read it.

news.title: News of what you hold and watch
news.description: Each listing is collected when its time comes, unless the agent already did. With web search set up, each collection uses the vendor's credits; announcements only reach back a day, so longer spans miss some.

themes.title: News for your themes
themes.description: Searches each theme's queries through your web search vendor, and a decisions model reads what they find against its signposts. Nothing is searched until the vendor's key is saved.

collections.change-failed: Couldn't change when it is collected

schedules.title: Scheduled tasks
schedules.description-text: Messages sent to the agent while Solyx is open, each run in a conversation of its own. An order it proposes still waits for you, and each run spends your model's tokens.
schedules.name: Name
schedules.prompt-description: Sent as you would write it. Start with /watchlist-upkeep for a round over what you hold and watch.
schedules.on-change-description: Runs when news suggests something a report or theme below watches for has happened, or a report's event date has passed. Checked every half hour.
schedules.on-change-minutes_one: When something changed, at most every {{count}} minute
schedules.on-change-minutes_other: When something changed, at most every {{count}} minutes
schedules.on-change-hours_one: When something changed, at most every {{count}} hour
schedules.on-change-hours_other: When something changed, at most every {{count}} hours

kind-names.falsifier-met: News may say what would change a report's view happened
kind-names.event-passed: A date a report holds has gone by
kind-names.signpost-met: News may say one of a theme's signposts happened

scope.every-listing: Every listing you hold and watch
scope.no-listings: You hold and watch no listings yet.
scope.kinds-required: Pick at least one kind of change

approval-descriptions.ask: The run rests at the first such call until you answer it in its conversation.
approval-descriptions.auto: Reads pages the run found, runs shell commands judged harmless and saves to memory; everything else waits for you.

schedules.secret: This looks like a key, token or ID number, which a task never holds

mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.description: Servers listed in {{path}}, in the mcpServers format Claude, Cursor and pi use. Write keys as secret:NAME and save them here. Each call asks first unless you let a read-only tool run on its own.
mcp.empty: No servers yet. Add one to mcp.json and it connects here.
mcp.tally: {{off}} off, {{ask}} ask each time, {{auto}} run on their own
mcp.set-label: When the agent uses any of these {{count}} tools

sign-in.label: Account
sign-in.hint: Signs in through your browser, where the server asks you to allow Solyx.

candles.title: Candle cache
candles.description: Closed sessions kept on this computer so charts don't download them again. Once cleared, charts fetch them as needed, using your plan's requests.
candles.confirm-body: Charts will download closed sessions again as they need them. Your watchlist, proposals and settings stay.

conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.description: Your conversations with the agent, and the folders their shell commands work in.
conversations.confirm-body: Their messages and the files their shell commands left are deleted, and any still running stops. This can't be undone. Orders they suggested stay in proposals.

memory.title: Memory
memory.description: What the agent keeps across conversations about you and your listings.
memory.confirm-body: The agent starts its next conversation knowing nothing from earlier ones. This can't be undone. Your conversations stay.

news.title: News
news.description: Stories collected for your listings, with their scores. Sources only reach back a few days, so older stories can't be collected again.
news.shorten-body: Stored {{kind}} older than {{days}} days are deleted now. Sources only reach back a few days, so they can't be collected again.
news.keep-failed: Couldn't change how long news is kept
news.confirm-body: Stories and their scores are deleted, and older ones can't be collected again. Watched listings collect recent news at their next refresh.

research.title: Research
research.description: The agent's reports on your listings and its forecasts, with how each came out. None of it can be made again.
research.confirm-body: Every report and forecast is deleted, with how the forecasts came out. This can't be undone. Your conversations stay.

watchlist.title: Watchlist
watchlist.description: The listings you watch, whose news is collected on a schedule.
watchlist.confirm-body: Every listing leaves the watchlist, and their news stops being collected on a schedule. This can't be undone. Their news and cached candles stay.

destination.title: Where backups go
destination.description: A bucket of your own on any S3-compatible service, such as Cloudflare R2, AWS, Backblaze B2 or MinIO. Backups are encrypted with your passphrase before they leave this computer.
destination.endpoint-description: The server's S3 endpoint, such as https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com. AWS needs none.
destination.endpoint-invalid: Enter an http or https address
destination.region-description: AWS and Backblaze B2 need the bucket's own region. Cloudflare R2 and MinIO take the default.
destination.region-invalid: Enter a region such as us-east-1
destination.bucket-description: A bucket you made, which the access key below may read and write.
destination.bucket-invalid: Enter the bucket's name: 3 to 63 letters, digits, dots and hyphens
destination.prefix-description: The folder in the bucket that backups go into.
destination.prefix-invalid: Enter folder names of letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores, with a slash between them

now.title: Back up
now.description: Holds everything Solyx keeps, with your settings and skills, except keys, sign-ins and cached candles.
now.automatic-description: While Solyx runs, backs up once one is due and something has changed. Older backups are thinned out, so the bucket holds 39 at most.
now.every-description: Each backup uploads everything again, so a shorter span uses more bandwidth but no more of the bucket.
now.background-failed: The last backup made on its own didn't go through
now.not-ready: Set the bucket, both parts of its access key and a passphrase first.

restore.title: Restore
restore.description: Replaces what Solyx keeps on this computer with a backup. On another computer, set the same bucket, access key and passphrase first, and enter your keys again after.
restore.empty: No backups in this folder yet
restore.confirm-body: Your data, settings and skills go back to the backup, and Solyx restarts. What's here now is moved aside, not deleted. Proposals waiting in the backup are dismissed. Keys and sign-ins stay as they are.

restored.title: Restored from the backup of {{time}}
restored.body: Proposals that were waiting then were dismissed. What this computer held before is in the restore folder of Solyx's data until the next restore.

restore-stuck.title: Solyx couldn't finish restoring your backup
restore-stuck.body:
{{reason}}

Solyx tries again the next time it starts. The backup and what was moved so far are in {{folder}}.

about.data-hint: Keys, databases and caches are kept here.
about.config-hint: You can also edit it by hand; saving applies the change.

telemetry.title: OpenTelemetry
telemetry.description: Sends traces and logs to an OpenTelemetry endpoint you choose, such as Grafana Cloud's. They hold models, token counts, timings and failures, never what a conversation says. Nothing is sent until an endpoint is set.
telemetry.endpoint-description: As OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT names it; traces go to /v1/traces and logs to /v1/logs.
telemetry.endpoint-invalid: Enter an http or https address

theme-watch.title: Themes
theme-watch.description-text: Events in the world the app watches for you, such as an outbreak, a conflict or a rule in the making. Each is searched once a day and stays quiet until news matches one of its signposts.
theme-watch.name: What is watched
theme-watch.queries-description_one: One a line, a few words each, in the languages its news is written in. Up to {{count}}.
theme-watch.queries-description_other: One a line, a few words each, in the languages its news is written in. Up to {{count}}.
theme-watch.signposts-description_one: One a line: something that happens and that a headline could state. Up to {{count}}.
theme-watch.signposts-description_other: One a line: something that happens and that a headline could state. Up to {{count}}.
theme-watch.listings-description: One a line, as market, code, a colon and how: TW 2603: port closures cut its sailings.
theme-watch.listing-format: Write each line as market, code, a colon and how, such as TW 2603: fewer sailings
theme-watch.secret: This looks like a key, token or ID number, which a theme never holds

trading.broker-description: Only you can switch it. A switch takes effect once Solyx restarts.

broker-hints.paper: Pretend money; every order fills at once.
broker-hints.fubon: Your own account, signed in as set up in Market data. Buys need a settlement account at Taipei Fubon Bank or LINE Bank; with another bank, only sales go.

trading.restart-description: Orders go to the {{account}} until Solyx restarts, and proposals waiting for you are dismissed then.
trading.lock-description: Refuses every order until you switch it off. The agent cannot change it.
trading.max-daily-loss-description: Once a day's sales lose this much, buys in this currency are refused; sales still go.

tray.title: Background
tray.show-menu-bar: Keep Solyx in the menu bar
tray.show-system-tray: Keep Solyx in the system tray
tray.show-description: Solyx keeps running there after its last window closes, so scheduled work goes on.
tray.hide-dock: Leave the Dock while no window is open
tray.hide-dock-description: The icon in the menu bar opens Solyx again.

updates.title: Updates
updates.automatic-description: Asks download.usesolyx.trade for a newer version a minute after Solyx starts and every six hours.

crash-reports.title: Help improve Solyx
crash-reports.description: When Solyx crashes or hits an error it didn't expect, it can send a report through Sentry so the bug gets fixed. Nothing is sent until you switch this on, and you can change it in Settings → About.
crash-reports.send-description: What went wrong and where in the code, with the versions of Solyx, Electron and your operating system. Reports leave out your keys, conversations, holdings and orders.

signed-in.title: Signed in to ChatGPT
signed-in.body: You can close this tab and return to Solyx.

failed.title: ChatGPT was not connected
failed.body: Return to Solyx and try signing in again.

signed-in.title: Authorization sent to Solyx
signed-in.body: You can close this tab. Solyx saves the key OpenRouter created for it.

failed.title: OpenRouter was not connected
failed.body: Return to Solyx and try signing in again.

signed-in.title: Authorization sent to Solyx
signed-in.body: You can close this tab. Solyx finishes connecting the MCP server.

failed.title: The MCP server was not connected
failed.body: Return to Solyx and try signing in again.
